title: Mark Carney: Canada has 'learned we are overdependent on the US'

blocks.text: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke to DW on Friday after talks in Montreal with European Union leaders seeking to hammer out details of a new, closer partnership between Canada and the EU. Amid difficult negotiations with US President Donald Trump, representing Canada’s biggest trading partner, Carney said that he and his compatriots had come to realize the country was too dependent on the economic powerhouse to the south. “The lesson we’ve taken, Canadians as a whole, is we’re overdependent on the United States.
